lines.text: The Commander opens his eyes.
He looks around. He's in the transport ship.
He always wakes up here.
The moment he does, he hears the ramp door opening.
He must be "set" to come to his senses the moment the ramp door opens.
It startled him at first, but he's used to it by now.
He hears the sound of footsteps.
That sound is always followed by her arrival.
The most precious thing in the world to him will soon be here to greet him with a smile.
The sound of steps grows closer.
Her face always makes him feel better, and her smile always warms his heart.
That alone is enough to make this endless cycle of death and resurrection worth...

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: No. 7. Come out.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Come out. Let's go up and have something to eat.
... Who... are you?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Hurry. We don't have time.
Doctor Maria turns and walks away.
The Commander follows with a puzzled look on his face.
A short way up the stairs, the space opens into a wide room.
A simple meal is laid out on the desk,
and there is Marian, looking at the Commander and smiling.
Marian.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Welcome, Commander.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Sit.
The Commander hesitates, then takes a seat.
He looks at Marian, who is still smiling at him, and smiles back.
After a moment, his eyes move to Doctor Maria, who takes the seat beside Marian.
She quietly picks up a piece of bread and puts it in her mouth.
Um...

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: This is our first time meeting, huh?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I'm Maria. The person who made Marian.
Oh...
So you're my mother-in-law.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Commander...!

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... You really are something...
It's a pleasure to meet you. I'm {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Yeah, I know.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I know what the two of you went through, and how you both feel.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I also know what kind of person you are.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... I've been watching this whole time.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: So we can skip the introductions.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: You don't need to know much about me.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: After today, we'll never see each other again anyway.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Tomorrow we'll be leaving here and going to the Ark.
... What?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: We reached the target location.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Now that all the tests are complete, we get to go to the Ark,

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: and start our real lives.
I can't believe it.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Hehe. Right? Me neither.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Doctor Maria called us here because she wanted to treat us after everything we've been through.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: So eat as much as you want and get some rest.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: That's right. Rest up before you go.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: And take care of yourselves in the Ark.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... You've earned it.
Thank... you.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: All right, now eat up before it gets cold.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Things are going to get busy again starting tomorrow, in a whole new way.
... Right.
The Commander reaches for the food.
Marian watches him intently, smiling.
The Commander looks at Marian and returns the smile.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... We have to erase all the records.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: If we miss anything, it will be traced back to you.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: That means getting rid of all the records from this lab, and even the ones Enikk is keeping privately.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Enikk?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... Yeah, just think of it like a supercomputer.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Also.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: No. 7's memories have to be erased.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: More specifically, the NIMPH attached to No. 7's body has to be erased.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: If it was ever discovered that he's a human with NIMPH, it would lead straight to you.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: They'd dig through every bit of the NIMPH,

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: and everything would go back to how it was. Someone would start this insane experiment all over again.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: That is why No. 7's NIMPH must be erased.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: And No. 7's body carries Vapaus, which means whenever the NIMPH flows into his brain, the Vapaus fights back.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... Gradually, the brain will break down, until at some point it completely breaks and he'll be brain-dead.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I see... I had suspected something like that.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Erasing No. 7's NIMPH is the right call, in more ways than one.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Did you ever notice anything strange about No. 7's body?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: NIMPH can't be put into an ordinary human brain. There must be an external device backing up his memories.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: We have to find it and destroy it.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Oh, the collarbone. There was definitely... something there.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: It felt strange when I touched it. I'm sure it wasn't a bone.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... Looks like all that touching wasn't for nothing.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Okay, that must be where the device housing the NIMPH is.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: It must be what's storing his memories.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Let's destroy it. It's the only way to keep No. 7 alive.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Once it's destroyed, No. 7's memories will gradually go away.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Everything except the memories from when he was first made will be gone.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... What do you mean...?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... All his memories with you will disappear.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: He'll probably only retain the memories up through his graduation from the academy, or right after it.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... You have to choose.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Either the two of you run off somewhere together, and you pray his mind holds out as long as possible,

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: or you erase his memories.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Can you make that choice?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: For me...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: If it means the Commander can live...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: If he can go on living in this world...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Then I can make that choice.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: You really are better than me in every way.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Okay, here we are.
Mmm...
Marian helps the Commander into the room.
She lays the swaying Commander down on the bed.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Phew...
Huh... I feel... weird...
I barely even... drank that much...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Hehe. You're probably just unwinding.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Something that felt never-ending is over now.
Yeah... it really does... feel like a dream...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Yeah... It felt just like a dream.
The Commander's eyes flutter. He's fighting with everything he has to stay awake.
The sleeping pills and sedative are fully taking hold now.
I can't keep... my eyes open... I'll go ahead... and sleep...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... Okay. Good night, Commander.
Let's go... on that picnic...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Yeah. We will.
... cute lunch box... sandwiches...
I love you, Marian.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I love you too.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Go to sleep now...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: When you wake up... everything will be... all right.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Okay...? So...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Sweet... dreams...
The Commander's eyes close.
She hears the faint sound of his breathing.
Marian watches him sleep for a long while.
She gently strokes his cheek and smooths his hair.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: This is the only way...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: There's nothing else we can do. It'll be okay...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: It'll all be okay...
Marian takes out a small gun-shaped instrument from her pocket.
She removes the Commander's shirt,
and brings the instrument to his collarbone.
*Drip, drip*
Marian's tears fall onto the Commander's face.
They fall, and fall, and keep falling.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Ngh... *Sob...!*

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Comman...der...!
All she has to do is pull the trigger, and it's done.
All his memories will disappear.
He won't remember her name,
or all the times they crossed between life and death together,
or any of the many promises they made.
It will all be gone.
She'll become a stranger to him,
someone he has never met before.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I will never... forget you.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: So I want you to also...
Marian presses her lips to the sleeping Commander's forehead.
She looks at his face without blinking.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... You know what, it's okay.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Forget me.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Forget all of this and go live.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Our story ends here.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: This is as far as it goes.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: You're heading out into the great, wide world, much bigger than our little one.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I want you to do what you want, to dream of the future, and to live.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Go to a lot of different places,

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: have a lot of different experiences,

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: and meet a lot of different people.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I want you to live a free life.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Please. For me.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I love you.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Goodbye.
Marian pulls the trigger on the device.
